description: Amid heightened global and domestic volatility, Indian equities retain long-term appeal, but HNIs are increasingly prioritising diversification, disciplined asset allocation and quality-focused strategies to manage near-term risks and build resilient portfolios.

title: Silver scales new peak at Rs 2.05 lakh/kg; gold just Rs 367 shy of peak. What's behind the rise?
description: Gold and silver futures surged on the MCX, with silver hitting a fresh lifetime high and gold nearing record levels, as rupee weakness and global cues supported prices amid heightened volatility ahead of key central bank meetings.

title: US jobs rebound masks softening trend, Fed seen holding steady in January
description: US job growth rebounded in November, but a higher unemployment rate and data distortions reinforced signs of a cooling labour market, supporting expectations that the Federal Reserve will hold rates steady in the near term while keeping the door open for rate cuts later in 2026.

title: Meesho shares hit 20% upper circuit, nearly double from IPO price. What’s triggering the rally?
description: Meesho's shares surged 20% to an intraday high of Rs 216.35 after UBS initiated coverage with a Buy rating, citing strong growth potential. The stock is now up 76% from its IPO price, boosting co-founder Vidit Aatrey into the billionaire club. UBS predicts robust Net Merchandise Value growth driven by user expansion and increased ordering frequency.

title: 75 stocks set to be Dhurandhar bets in 2026, six brokerages tell investors
description: Six major brokerages have identified 75 heavyweight Indian stocks they expect to lead the market if conditions improve in 2026. Firms including Morgan Stanley, HSBC, BofA, Nomura, Jefferies and ICICI Direct see easing financial conditions, an earnings recovery and low foreign positioning as key tailwinds after India’s weak relative performance. Their Sensex and Nifty targets point to steady, earnings-driven gains rather than sharp valuation-led rallies.

title: Axis Bank among 7 F&O stocks showing a sharp rise in futures open interest
description: Seven stocks in the NSE F&O segment witnessed a sharp rise in futures open interest as of December 16, signalling increased derivatives activity. Axis Bank, Jubilant FoodWorks, Mankind Pharma, HDFC AMC, Bharat Dynamics, Piramal Pharma and PB Fintech recorded notable OI gains, reflecting fresh positions and expanding trader participation.

title: Sensex, Nifty flat at open after 2-day slide amid mixed global cues
description: Indian stock markets opened flat on Wednesday. The Sensex and Nifty showed little movement after recent declines. Investors are carefully watching global markets. US jobs data provided mixed signals. This data did not significantly alter interest rate expectations. Trading is currently steady with minor gains and losses.

title: RailTel shares jump 2% on reports of talks with Elon Musk’s Starlink for broadband partnership
description: RailTel shares: The PSU is reportedly in talks with Elon Musk-owned Starlink for a potential partnership in India. The discussions are linked to Starlink’s planned India launch, with RailTel exploring the use of satellite internet to offer retail broadband, particularly for last-mile and rural connectivity.

title: India's trade impasse with Trump keeps rupee in the cold
description: India's rupee is experiencing a sharp decline against the dollar. This is driven by U.S. tariffs and investors withdrawing funds. Experts suggest the rupee may weaken further until a trade agreement is finalized. This situation presents challenges for global investors. However, some analysts see potential for Indian assets to rebound in 2026.

title: KSH International IPO Day 2: Check GMP, subscription status, brokerage view and key highlights
description: The Rs 710 crore KSH International IPO entered Day 2 with marginally improved sentiment as GMP rose to about 1.6%. Day 1 subscription stood at 15%, led by retail investors, while QIB interest remained absent. Analysts see limited listing gains but highlight long-term prospects.

title: Akzo Nobel shares nosedive 15% as Imperial Chemical likely offloads 48.8 lakh shares via block deal
description: Akzo Nobel India shares plunged 15% to Rs 3,080 on Wednesday following reports of Imperial Chemical Industries selling a 9% stake via a block deal at a discounted price. This occurred despite the company reporting a significant 2119.8% rise in Q2FY2025-26 net profit, though revenue and EBIT saw slight declines.

title: Hindustan Zinc shares surge 3% to new 52-week high as silver surges to fresh high, crosses $65. Should you buy, sell or hold?
description: Hindustan Zinc's stock has soared to a new 52-week peak, energized by a remarkable uptick in silver prices. Analysts are optimistic about the company's earnings trajectory, forecasting robust growth ahead. With the dual advantage of rising silver and zinc prices, along with efficient mining operations that bolster profitability, investors are keenly monitoring whether this positive momentum will sustain.

title: Mega IPOs smash the villain tag in 2025, delivering nearly 3x returns of smaller listings
description: India’s IPO market in 2025 is defying conventional wisdom, with large IPOs significantly outperforming smaller issues. Offerings above Rs 5,000 crore have delivered average listing gains of 22%, nearly three times the 7.5% returns from IPOs below Rs 1,000 crore and well above the broader market average.

title: HDFC Securities picks SBI Life, ICICI Lombard among top picks amid sweeping insurance law overhaul talks
description: As the government prepares to table a sweeping insurance reform Bill in Parliament, HDFC Securities flags SBI Life, ICICI Lombard, Niva Bupa and Policybazaar as key beneficiaries, saying the proposed changes could improve ease of doing business and expand reinsurance capacity without materially intensifying competition.

title: Vedanta, LT Foods and 2 other stocks flash bullish signals, indicating possible uptrend
description: Four stocks with market capitalisation above Rs 1,000 crore appeared in the White Marubozu bullish scan on December 16, signalling strong buying interest. The candlestick pattern reflects firm buyer dominance throughout the session, indicating a possible continuation of the upward trend as momentum and sentiment strengthen.

title: Caplin Point bets big on US, complex injectables to drive next growth phase: COO
description: Caplin Point is building a strong growth runway with over 40 US approvals, a 60-plus product pipeline and aggressive capacity expansion, says COO Vivek Partheeban. While growth may moderate in the near term, the US business, larger Latin American markets and complex products could drive a sharper pickup from FY28 onwards.

title: Silver tops $65 for first time; gold firms as US unemployment rate climbs
description: Silver surged to a record high above $65 an ounce on Wednesday, driven by weaker U.S. labor data that fueled expectations of interest rate cuts. Gold also climbed, with both precious metals benefiting from a weaker dollar and a shift towards non-yielding assets in a low-rate environment. Investors now await key U.S. inflation data.

title: Crypto exchange HashKey debuts in Hong Kong amid market volatility
description: HashKey Holdings saw its shares climb on its Hong Kong market debut, raising $206 million in an IPO. Despite recent cryptocurrency volatility, the company's chairman expressed optimism for digital assets, citing growing regulatory frameworks. Hong Kong's embrace of digital assets contrasts with mainland China's stricter stance, benefiting HashKey's expansion plans.

title: Ola Electric shares rally 5% as Bhavish Aggarwal sells 2.6 cr shares via bulk deal to repay promoter loan, release pledge
description: Ola Electric shares surged after promoter Bhavish Aggarwal sold over 2.6 crore equity shares to repay a Rs 260 crore loan. This move released previously pledged shares, removing a critical overhang. Despite the recent stock pressure and business challenges, the promoter group maintains a significant stake.

title: Indian Oil Corporation dividend alert: Last day to buy shares to be eligible for Rs 5 interim dividend
description: Indian Oil Corporation has announced an interim dividend of Rs 5 per share for FY26. Investors must buy shares before the ex-dividend cut-off to be eligible. The PSU continues its long dividend track record, offering steady income appeal, with payouts scheduled within the stipulated timeline.

title: Bharti Airtel, Bajaj Auto and 3 other stocks showing bullish RSI upswing
description: Five Nifty200 stocks showed improving momentum on 16 December as their RSI readings crossed above the 50 mark. This shift signals strengthening price action and early accumulation. Rising RSI levels often indicate a developing bullish bias, offering traders early insight into potential upside as sentiment and trend strength improve.

title: Bumper IT buyback helps India ETF pull off rare index beat
description: Aditya Birla Sun Life Nifty 50 ETF has outperformed its benchmark by nearly 12% this financial year, a feat achieved by strategically tendering shares into a buyback at a premium. This "passive-plus" approach, also benefiting its Nifty IT ETF, aims to offset fees and generate incremental alpha for investors.

title: ICICI Prudential AMC IPO Allotment Status Live: how to check allotment status on NSE, BSE & Kfin website ; GMP at nearly 17%. Listing to take place on Dec 19
Mukul Agrawal, Ramesh Damani-backed Protean eGov Technologies shares in focus on 4.95% stake acquisition in NSDL Payments Bank
description: Protean eGov Technologies is set to gain investor attention after announcing its acquisition of a 4.95% stake in NSDL Payments Bank. This strategic move aims to bolster Protean's digital financial infrastructure, fostering partnerships and developing scalable solutions for underserved segments. The collaboration leverages NSDL Payments Bank's digital-first platform to expand Protean's reach in citizen-centric financial services.

title: Vedanta shares in focus as NCLT approves demerger into independent listed companies
description: Vedanta's demerger plan has received formal approval from the NCLT. This will create five separate listed companies. Vedanta Aluminium, Vedanta Oil & Gas, Vedanta Power, and Vedanta Iron & Steel will become independent. The residual Vedanta Limited will house Hindustan Zinc. This move aims for sharper focus and independent capital access for each business.

title: Bajaj Auto Share Price Live Updates: Bajaj Auto's Price Movement Today
Oil jumps 1.5% as Trump's Venezuela blockade stokes uncertainty
description: Oil prices rose more than 1% on Wednesday after U.S. President Donald Trump ordered "a total and complete" blockade of all sanctioned oil tankers entering and leaving Venezuela, raising fresh geopolitical tensions at a time of concerns over demand.

title: Vietnam raises $514 mln in government bond auction, highest in 6 months
description: Vietnam's State Treasury raised 13.55 trillion dong ($514 million) in a weekly government bond auction on Wednesday, the highest volume in six months and up from $302 million raised last week.

title: Japan's Nikkei ends higher as tech shares track Nasdaq gains
description: Japan's Nikkei share average closed higher, rebounding from a two-week low hit in the previous session, as technology stocks tracked overnight gains on the Nasdaq.

title: PSU Banks steal the show in 2025: Is the rally far from over?
description: PSU banks have emerged as the top performers in 2025, with the Nifty PSU Bank Index rising over 26%, far ahead of the broader market. Strong earnings, improved asset quality and attractive valuations have driven gains, though performance remains uneven across lenders. Analysts see momentum sustaining over the next few quarters.

title: Rupee whipsaws after RBI steps in. What's in store for Dalal Street investors?
description: The Indian rupee saw a sharp intraday reversal after the RBI intervened aggressively to curb its fall, highlighting fragile market sentiment. Heavy dollar selling by the central bank pushed the rupee from near 91 to an intraday high of 89.75 per dollar before it settled around 90.28.

title: Castrol India, Akzo Nobel among top 10 smallcap stocks that are offering dividend yield of 5-8%
InvITs & REITs see robust growth in distributions in Q2 FY2026 backed by strong operating metrics across assets: ICRA Analytics
description: India’s InvIT and REIT distributions surged in Q2 FY2026, led by strong performance in REITs and road assets. Both public and private trusts reported robust quarter-on-quarter and year-on-year growth, supported by healthy operating metrics and new listings.

title: ICICI Prudential AMC gets first 'buy' call ahead of listing, PL sets Rs 3,000 target
description: ICICI Prudential AMC has received its first buy rating ahead of listing, with PL Capital setting a Rs 3,000 target, implying 39% upside from the IPO price. The brokerage cites strong parentage, market-leading equity flows, consistent fund performance and superior profitability as key drivers for long-term growth.

title: Midcaps, smallcaps turn attractive on earnings revival; financials to lead next rally: Dinshaw Irani
description: Midcaps and smallcaps are turning attractive after a 14-month consolidation as earnings rebound and growth-adjusted valuations improve, according to Helios MF CEO Dinshaw Irani. He believes retail caution and not weak fundamentals, is holding smallcaps back, and further expects financials—especially consumer-facing banks—to lead the next market rally once margins stabilise.

title: Mukesh Ambani’s RIL will see rating upgrades every quarter in 2026, says Morgan Stanley. 4 reasons why
description: Morgan Stanley expects Reliance Industries to see rating upgrades every quarter in 2026 as its energy, retail and telecom businesses turn free cash flow positive. The brokerage has reiterated an overweight rating with a Rs 1,847 target, citing a refining upcycle, retail recovery, telecom cash flows and a chemicals turnaround.
